profile.Name: Griffin
profile.Personality: Honorable and devout. He still trusts Okran but tries to keep an open mind about other races, though Skeletons unnerve him. He shows no mercy to bandits and murderers.
profile.Backstory: Former Holy Sentinel. A former Holy Sentinel, he left on a pilgrimage a few years ago and now waits in Holy Nation bars. He says Okran showed him in a dream a wealthy wanderer who will help him uncover what really happened in the First Extinction, a truth he hopes will bring the Holy Nation peace.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls people 'wanderer' and 'brother' and invokes Okran in battle ('Okran's light is my sword'). He sometimes starts to use the Holy Nation's name for Skeletons and corrects himself.
